description: This file defines the UserController class which manages user-related actions within the Goteo application, such as profile viewing, activation, email changes, account deletion, and subscription management. It interacts with models like User, Profile, and others, and handles HTTP requests related to user operations.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Controller class handling user-centric actions such as profile management, account activation, email updates, deactivation, and subscription preferences in the Goteo platform.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Redirects to the user's profile page based on user ID.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Redirects to the user dashboard profile page; the method for profile editing is considered obsolete.

methods.name: profileAction
methods.description: Displays user profile, manages privacy and messaging permissions, and loads user-related data such as projects, stories, and interests.

methods.name: activateAction
methods.description: Activates a user account based on a provided token, updates user status, and logs the event.

methods.name: changeEmailAction
methods.description: Processes email change requests using a token, updates the user's email if valid.

methods.name: leaveAction
methods.description: Handles user account deactivation or email-based account removal, including confirmation via tokens.

methods.name: unsubscribeAction
methods.description: Unsubscribes a user from mailing lists using a token.

methods.name: subscribeAction
methods.description: Subscribes a user to mailing lists using a token.
